title: Holonet demonstrator versus fault-tolerant milestone dashboards
purpose: Separate near-term single-photon falsifiers from long-term GKP/Steinberg fault-tolerance milestones so the architecture claim is not confused with a hardware-threshold claim.

source_boundaries.single_photon_demonstrator: Unencoded logical holonet: polarization/path plus time-bin qutrits, tritter F3, delay ladder, EOM, recirculation loop, and single-photon detection. Tests substrate logic, holonomy, and quasicrystal clock; it is not fault-tolerant because fixed photon number cannot carry a many-photon GKP grid state.
source_boundaries.fault_tolerant_machine: Concatenated CV stack: 240 squeezed modes -> 120 D4 GKP pairs -> 240 GKP qutrits -> [[240,81,4]]_3 Steinberg code -> 81 logical qutrits. Open bottleneck is GKP-state generation at threshold squeezing and associated syndrome extraction.

near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.name: Trace-Choi visibility calibration
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.claim: Prepared temporal Bell qutrit gives V(U)=|Tr U|/3 with V(F3)=1/3 and V(X)=V(Z)=0.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.measurement: Single-photon interferometric process/readout visibility across inserted U.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.pass_condition: Visibility values match the exact qutrit trace law within experimental uncertainty.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.falsifies_if: Visibility spectrum cannot be fit by |Tr U|/3 for the claimed qutrit registers.

near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.name: Holonomic timing-independence
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.claim: Gate unitary depends on path in control space, not speed or pulse schedule.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.measurement: Reparameterize the same loop with varied timing/pulse shapes and compare gate tomography.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.pass_condition: Same path gives same unitary up to lab error and global phase.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.falsifies_if: Gate changes systematically with timing while path is held fixed.

near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.name: 2T/SL(2,3) holonomy fingerprint
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.claim: Single-qutrit geometric gates close into 2T=SL(2,3), order 24, with element-order spectrum {1,1,8,6,8}.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.measurement: Gate-set tomography and closure table over generated single-qutrit Clifford elements.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.pass_condition: Recovered multiplication table and order spectrum match 2T modulo Pauli/global phase.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.falsifies_if: Generated holonomy group has the wrong order or order spectrum.

near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.name: BC quasicrystal aperiodicity
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.claim: BC twist angle arccos(-2/3) is irrational relative to pi and therefore never recurs exactly.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.measurement: Stroboscopic phase/orbit reconstruction over repeated recirculation passes.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.pass_condition: No recurrence and gap pattern consistent with the irrational BC drive, after accounting for finite coherence window.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.falsifies_if: A genuine recurrence appears at a finite pass not attributable to hardware locking or loss.

near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.name: Spin-1 topological pump protection
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.claim: Rotation-realized qutrit two-tone pump has extremal Chern magnitude |C|=2 over the topological regime.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.measurement: Frequency-conversion response or synthetic-parameter Berry-curvature/Chern reconstruction.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.pass_condition: Quantized transfer/protection corresponds to Chern magnitude 2 before the m=2 gap closing.
near_term_demonstrator_falsifiers.falsifies_if: The qutrit pump is topologically trivial or has only qubit-strength |C|=1 in the claimed rotation realization.

fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.name: Threshold squeezed-light resource
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.target: Protocol-dependent approximately 7-20 dB, with D4/E8 coding gains reducing the effective burden by 1.5/3.0 dB.
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.evidence_needed: Mode-resolved squeezing, loss budget, and noise model sufficient for qutrit GKP decoding.

fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.name: Qutrit GKP state generation
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.target: Reliable finite-squeezing qutrit GKP states in the D4 two-mode lattice or equivalent measurement-based preparation.
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.evidence_needed: State tomography or decoder-level evidence that prepared states support qutrit displacement-error correction.

fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.name: D4 inner analog-to-digital code
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.target: 120 D4 GKP pairs converting continuous displacement noise into 240 discrete qutrit error channels.
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.evidence_needed: Closest-lattice-point/syndrome decoding demonstration and coding-gain measurement.

fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.name: Steinberg outer code
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.target: [[240,81,4]]_3 outer code over the W(3,3) 240-edge carrier.
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.evidence_needed: Syndrome extraction and logical-error suppression consistent with distance-4 qutrit code behavior.

fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.name: Cubic non-Gaussian resource
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.target: Degree-3 E6 matter-shell magic implemented by cubic phase/magic-state injection or a chi^(3) medium.
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.evidence_needed: Non-Gaussian resource certification and compatibility with GKP/Steinberg Clifford layer.

fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.name: Integrated Sp(4,3) Clifford network
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.target: Programmable beamsplitter/phase/squeeze/modulator network realizing the two-qutrit Clifford action on encoded qutrits.
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.evidence_needed: Encoded gate tomography and closure under Sp(4,3) modulo Pauli/frame conventions.

fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.name: Homodyne and qutrit syndrome readout
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.target: Stable readout of inner GKP shifts and outer Steinberg syndromes without collapsing the protected logical register.
fault_tolerant_machine_milestones.evidence_needed: Repeated syndrome extraction with tracked logical frame and below-threshold residual displacement noise.

honesty_boundary: The near-term demonstrator can falsify the substrate-level logic, holonomy, and BC clock without proving fault tolerance. The fault-tolerant machine requires the full CV GKP/Steinberg stack and should not be claimed from a single fixed-photon-number experiment.
